The My Health Care plan from Bajaj Allianz Health Insurance has transitioned its OPD (Outpatient Department) feature to a strictly cashless-only model, meaning you can no longer file for reimbursement of expenses paid out-of-pocket.
The primary drawbacks to this system include:
Restricted Network: The list of empanelled doctors and facilities is highly limited; for example, there are currently only about 25 participating hospitals in Mumbai.
Geographic & Choice Constraints: Because you must use the app to select a provider, you may struggle to find a doctor near your home or one that fits your specific medical needs.
Inflated Costs: OPD fees within the network are often higher than standard market rates, and the plan does not offer discounted rates for follow-up consultations.
